summary_md: **Chenxi.AI ([@LuckyChenxi](https://x.com/LuckyChenxi/status/2116563458296815776))** breaks down IBM's *Think Before You Act* by Shoham et al. ([arXiv 2610.38620](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38620)): **JevAct** checks agent actions before writes or escalations using code for computable facts and a small decision model for yes/no policy questions, lifting Opus 4.6's pass^3 on tau2-bench Telecom from 39.5% to 80.7%; gains varied on other domains, and he suggests an AGENTS.md rule or a PreToolUse hook as an approximation.

referenced_urls.title: Think Before You Act: Decision Gate for LLM Agents
